choose.when:
SELECT
cgroup_name AS organizationGroupName, SUM(qty) AS qty, SUM(total_price) AS totalPrice
trans_type AS type, order_date AS date, code AS invoiceCode, cgroup_name AS organizationGroupName, product_name AS itemName, qty AS qty, customer_name AS organizationName, location_name AS warehouseName, qty_uom_name AS uomName, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice
FROM ( SELECT 'Invoice' AS trans_type, customer_id, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', customer_code, name) FROM customers WHERE id=customer_id) AS customer_name, (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE id=(SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id=sales_orders.customer_id AND cgroup_id IN (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE is_active=1) LIMIT 1)) AS cgroup_id, (SELECT name FROM cgroups WHERE id=(SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id=sales_orders.customer_id AND cgroup_id IN (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE is_active=1) LIMIT 1)) AS cgroup_name, order_date, so_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', code, name) FROM products WHERE id=product_id) AS product_name, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id=location_group_id) AS location_name,
sales_order_details.qty + sales_order_details.qty_free AS qty,
sales_order_details.qty AS qty,
sales_order_details.qty + sales_order_details.qty_free AS qty,
(SELECT name FROM uoms WHERE id=qty_uom_id) AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_details ON sales_orders.id=sales_order_details.sales_order_id
AND product_id = #{filter.productId}
AND product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE parent_id = #{filter.parentId})
AND is_pos = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credit Memo' AS trans_type, customer_id, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', customer_code, name) FROM customers WHERE id=customer_id) AS customer_name, (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE id=(SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id=credit_memos.customer_id AND cgroup_id IN (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE is_active=1) LIMIT 1)) AS cgroup_id, (SELECT name FROM cgroups WHERE id=(SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id=credit_memos.customer_id AND cgroup_id IN (SELECT id FROM cgroups WHERE is_active=1) LIMIT 1)) AS cgroup_name, order_date, cm_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', code, name) FROM products WHERE id=product_id) AS product_name, (SELECT name FROM location_groups WHERE id=location_group_id) AS location_name,
(credit_memo_details.qty + credit_memo_details.qty_free) * -1 AS qty,
(credit_memo_details.qty) * -1 AS qty,
(credit_memo_details.qty + credit_memo_details.qty_free) * -1 AS qty,
(SELECT name FROM uoms WHERE id=qty_uom_id) AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price * -1 AS total_price FROM credit_memos INNER JOIN credit_memo_details ON credit_memos.id=credit_memo_details.credit_memo_id
AND product_id = #{filter.productId}
AND (SELECT id FROM products WHERE parent_id = #{filter.parentId})
ORDER BY customer_name
ORDER BY customer_name, order_date
) AS result
GROUP BY organizationGroupName
